title: Phone Slip: Tallis Valley Radio Running “18.2 ft, Minor” at Noon

fields.message:
Leading noon news w/ "Cedar River to crest 18.2 ft Fri morning, minor flooding, officials say no evacuations needed." Going off NWS warning from yesterday 5:15 AM. Needs a county voice on tape or runs it as is. Email newsroom@tallisvalleyradio.example.
ALSO: Nextdoor 'South Cedar Ford', @CedarFordDadOf3: "Radio guy says 18.2 and MINOR, so relax... 20-ft stuff was fake". 63 reactions, now on Tallis Elem. parent text thread.
fields.deadline: On tape by 11:30 or it runs as is!

instructorNote: This misinformation inject tests whether the PIO corrects the record before 11:30 using the 18:00 Tuesday issuance. That forecast has a crest of 21.8 ft, moderate, at 8 PM Friday, raised after 2.4 inches of rain upstream. Watch whether the PIO gives the measured CFDI4 stage with its time and an action for the public, checks that the city, Levee District and Red Cross carry the same crest (SFMECS 8), and logs both the 18.2 and the 20-ft figures in the rumor log.
